content:
The **Bone Club** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A weathered Scorchbeast bone with protruding chunks of Ultracite. [1] In addition to dealing Physical Damage, each attack also deals Bleeding Damage over 15 seconds.

| **Upgrade** | | | | | | | | | | | | 
| Mod | Description | Naming | Effects | | | | | Plan | Components | Form ID | | 
| No Upgrade | Standard. | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | – | | 
| Wounding | Target bleeds. | – | – | + | – | – | – | – | – | 00349E45 | | 

 The Wounding modification cannot be learned or crafted, and displays no name text. **[Patched]** [2]
